$comment: #EXP-1640 (owner 2026-11-06): SIRI, SHORTCUTS, THE ACTION BUTTON AND THE ASSISTANTS ×2 (iOS App Intents + an `AppShortcutsProvider`, so the intents also reach Spotlight, the Shortcuts app, the Action button and Apple Intelligence; Android App Actions: `shortcuts.xml` `<capability>`s for Gemini / Assistant; web and desktop have none). Model = pure `intentIssueTitle` + `intentBoard` + `matchIntentAgent` (src/app-intents.ts; iOS ExpCore `AppIntentsModel.swift`, Android `domain/AppIntents.kt`), every mirror replays the `*Cases`. TWO INTENTS on the ACTIVE account. `create-issue` (iOS `CreateIssueIntent`, parameters title + an optional board entity listing the account's boards; Android `actions.intent.CREATE_THING`, `thing.name` = the title): the title goes through `intentIssueTitle` (an empty one asks for it again: `copy.askTitle`), the board is `intentBoard` (the picked one, else the board this account opened last in the app, else the first board in sidebar order, else `copy.noBoard`), then the app creates the issue through THE issues.create path the New issue page uses (no other field, status = the board default) and answers `copy.created` with its identifier, WITHOUT opening the app; tapping the answer opens THE issue page. `ask-agent` (iOS `AskAgentIntent`, parameters an agent entity listing agent-settings.json `orderedAgents` + the text; Android `actions.intent.CREATE_MESSAGE`, `message.recipient.name` = the spoken agent name, `message.text` = the text): the agent is `matchIntentAgent` (none spoken = the first of `orderedAgents`, the member's Assistant; no match = `copy.noAgent`), the text is sent as the member's message to THAT agent's conversation through THE composer's send path (sessions.send; an encrypted conversation is sealed ON THE PHONE with the tree key exactly like the composer, the text never leaves in clear), and the app opens that conversation. Signed out: `copy.signedOut`, nothing runs. App Shortcut phrases (`phrases`) are each platform's spoken entry points; every iOS phrase names the app. No new component.

copy.noBoard: Open Exponential and create a board first

boardCases.name: a last board that is gone: the first in sidebar order

agentCases.name: else a prefix, in agent order
another member's Assistant is never matched
